name: Eliakim
bio: Eliakim son of Hilkiah was in charge of Hezekiah's household. Along with Shebna the scribe and Joah the recorder, he went out to meet Sennacherib's officers Tartan, Rabsaris, and Rabshakeh when they came against Jerusalem, and heard Rabshakeh's mocking speech threatening the city and urging surrender. Eliakim asked Rabshakeh to speak in Aramaic rather than Hebrew so the people on the wall wouldn't understand, but Rabshakeh refused and shouted his threats in Hebrew anyway. Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah returned to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, reporting Rabshakeh's words (2 Kings 18:18-37). His continued role as a trusted official is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
